cues.zh: 文章里说，
cues.en: and in it they said,

cues.zh: 贾尼别科夫陀螺的旋转令人震惊，同时也带来危险
cues.en: the spinning nut of Dzhanibekov caused astonishment and simultaneous danger

cues.zh: 对科学界的某些人来说
cues.en: to a certain part of the scientific world

cues.zh: 有人提出了一个假说
cues.en: a hypothesis was proposed

cues.zh: 认为我们的星球在轨道运动过程中，也会发生同样的翻转
cues.en: that our planet, in the course of its orbital motion, can execute the same overturn

cues.zh: 那么，我们如何评估这个假说的有效性呢？
cues.en: So, how do we assess the validity of this hypothesis?

cues.zh: 我是说，地球真的会翻转过来吗？
cues.en: I mean, is the earth actually going to flip over?

cues.zh: 我们可以从一些简单的实验中得到线索
cues.en: well we can get some clues from simple experiments

cues.zh: 这些实验由宇航员 Don Pettit 在空间站上完成
cues.en: performed by astronaut Don Pettit aboard the space station

cues.zh: 他展示了书会像我们预期的那样，绕第一轴或第三轴稳定旋转
cues.en: he shows that a book will spin stably about its first or third axis just as we'd expect

cues.zh: 实心圆柱体也会绕第一轴或第三轴稳定旋转
cues.en: and a solid cylinder will also spin stably around its first or third axis

cues.zh: 但装满液体的圆柱体绕第一轴旋转时——也就是转动惯量最小的那根轴，
cues.en: but a liquid filled cylinder spinning about the first axis-- that's the one with the smallest moment of inertia,

cues.zh: 它是不稳定的
cues.en: it's unstable

cues.zh: 最终会绕转动惯量最大的轴旋转
cues.en: and it'll end up rotating about its axis with the largest moment of inertia

cues.zh: 为什么会这样？
cues.en: Why is this?

cues.zh: 对于一个在太空中旋转的孤立物体，
cues.en: For an isolated object spinning in space,

cues.zh: 你可能会以为它的角动量和动能都是恒定的
cues.en: you'd probably think both its angular momentum and its kinetic energy would be constant

cues.zh: 但这只说对了一半。
cues.en: but, that's only half true.

cues.zh: 角动量保持不变，
cues.en: angular momentum stays constant,

cues.zh: 但动能可以转化为其他形式的能量，比如热能
cues.en: but kinetic energy can be converted into other forms of energy, like heat

cues.zh: 所以在这种情况下，随着液体在里面晃荡，能量可以被耗散掉
cues.en: So, in this case, as the liquid's sloshing around inside, the energy can be dissipated

cues.zh: 而绕转动惯量最小的轴旋转
cues.en: and spinning about the axis with the smallest moment of inertia

cues.zh: 也意味着以最大的动能旋转
cues.en: also means spinning with the greatest kinetic energy

cues.zh: 随着这部分动能被耗散，
cues.en: and as this kinetic energy is dissipated,

cues.zh: 圆柱体别无选择，只能绕达到最小动能的那根轴旋转
cues.en: the cylinder has no other option but to spin about the axis that achieves the minimum kinetic energy

cues.zh: 也就是转动惯量最大的那根轴，
cues.en: and that is the one with the largest moment of inertia,

cues.zh: 所以当它像翻跟头一样旋转时
cues.en: so when it's rotating end-over-end

cues.zh: 在给定角动量的情况下，就是以最大转动惯量旋转
cues.en: for a given amount of angular momentum then, rotating with the maximum moment of inertia

cues.zh: 这是最低能量状态
cues.en: is the lowest energy state

cues.zh: 所以这是所有物体都会趋向的状态
cues.en: so that is the state that all bodies will tend towards

cues.zh: 只要它们有任何耗散能量的方式
cues.en: if they have any way of dissipating their energy

cues.zh: 美国的第一颗卫星——探险者一号——就吃过这个苦头
cues.en: the u.s. learned this the hard way with their first satellite-- the Explorer one

cues.zh: 它被设计成绕长轴旋转，以保持自旋稳定
cues.en: it was designed to spin about its long axis and be spin stabilized

cues.zh: 但进入轨道后几小时内，它就变成了翻滚式旋转
cues.en: but within hours of achieving orbit it was rotating end over end

cues.zh: 可这是怎么回事？看起来明明是个刚性圆柱体
cues.en: But, what happened? I mean it seems like a rigid cylinder

cues.zh: 问题出在那些柔性天线上
cues.en: Well the problem was these flexible antennas

cues.zh: 它们来回摆动时让卫星得以耗散能量
cues.en: they allowed the satellite to dissipate energy as they swung back and forth

cues.zh: 逐渐降低了卫星的动能
cues.en: gradually reducing the kinetic energy of the satellite

cues.zh: 直到它不得不绕使其转动惯量最大的轴旋转
cues.en: until it had to rotate by the axis that maximized its moment of inertia

cues.zh: 地球也是这样。
cues.en: Now the earth is just like this.

cues.zh: 它内部有耗散能量的方式，
cues.en: It has ways of dissipating energy internally,

cues.zh: 所以随着时间推移，它也变成了绕转动惯量最大的轴自转
cues.en: So over time it has come to spin about the axis with maximum moment of inertia

cues.zh: 大多数天体也是如此。
cues.en: and most astronomical objects do the same.

cues.zh: 以火星为例，它有一个质量集中区，或者说是一个巨大的正重力异常区，叫做塔尔西斯隆起
cues.en: Mars for example has a mass concentration or major positive gravity anomaly called the Tharsis Rise

cues.zh: 它恰好位于赤道上，这并非巧合
cues.en: and it is located, not coincidentally, at the equator

cues.zh: 因为这样能让它尽可能远离自转轴
cues.en: because that puts it as far as possible from the axis of rotation

cues.zh: 从而确保火星以最大转动惯量旋转
cues.en: and ensures that Mars is rotating with the maximum moment of inertia

cues.zh: 大多数小行星远非绕随机轴旋转，
cues.en: Most asteroids, far from rotating about random axes,

cues.zh: 它们几乎全都绕着转动惯量最大的轴旋转
cues.en: They spin, almost all of them around the axis with the maximum moment of inertia

cues.zh: 所以地球不会翻转。
cues.en: So the Earth won't flip.

cues.zh: 它正绕着转动惯量最大的轴旋转
cues.en: It's spinning about the axis with the maximum moment of inertia

cues.zh: 而这是稳定的。
cues.en: And that is stable.
